purpose: Predeclared acceptance criteria for the MEVA remediation.

static_package_gate.pass_condition: Every AC marked static passes with no unexpected valid or invalid fixture result.

runtime_activation_gate.pass_condition: Runtime-owned evidence binds the active session to the expected project, role, ticket, configuration, model, policy, package digests, and effective permissions.
runtime_activation_gate.fallback: Static conformance never upgrades missing runtime evidence; activation remains unverified.

acceptance_criteria.claim: The package contains the required bootstrap and complete operating manual in AGENTS.md, config, schema, state example, validator, reviewer handbook, tests, and exactly five unique spawnable worker roles.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: All required artifacts exist, no meva_orchestrator custom-agent file exists, and the restricted role/config loader reports no duplicate or unsupported definition.

acceptance_criteria.claim: One schema is the machine-readable authority for roles, states, risk tiers, safety tiers, classifications, environments, results, severities, priorities, dispositions, and recommendations.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Exact set equality across schema-backed fixtures and zero legacy aliases in normative contracts.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Canonical state, task, handoff, approval, budget, finding, gate, evidence, and runtime-attestation records validate deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Every valid fixture is accepted and every single-fault mutation is rejected; unknown fields are rejected except under extensions.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Declared authority is the intersection of human authority, role maximum, task scope, and attested runtime capability; broader or unknown authority never expands a ticket.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Read-only writes, scope escape, authorship conflict, unknown consequential authority, and broader-than-ticket actions fail closed.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Approval use requires a trusted-source verification and exact match on identifier, action, scope, environment, limits, status, and UTC expiry.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Missing or self-asserted verification, superset/substring scope, mismatch, revocation, and now greater than or equal to expiry reject.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Budget, external-call, delegation-depth, action-chain, retry, and persistent-resource accounting has deterministic stop behavior.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: At 70 percent notify/re-estimate; at 90 percent deny fan-out/nonessential work; at 100 percent deny ordinary work while allowing only cleanup or emergency safe-stop; any hard-limit excess rejects.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Only declared lifecycle transitions are accepted and requirement/interface changes invalidate all affected downstream evidence until acknowledgement and rerun.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: All legal transitions pass; skips, terminal resume, stale acknowledgement, and premature resume reject; transitive invalidation is complete and does not touch unrelated evidence.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Risk classification is consequence-based, R0 permits a no-delegation fast path, and Validation and Reviewer are never folded when both gates apply.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Local reversible non-consequential work is not escalated by keywords alone; production, sensitive-data, material-spend, consequential-autonomy, or physical blast radius triggers the appropriate higher tier.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Reviewer severity and P0-P3 remediation priority are independent and gate evaluation ignores priority.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Open critical is P0 and blocks; open high is P0 or P1 and blocks; priority cannot lower severity, disposition, approval requirements, or release blocking.

acceptance_criteria.claim: State and handoffs record effective runtime, model, provider, policy, config, manual, schema, role, ticket, and artifact provenance using explicit unknown values.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Missing required provenance rejects; unknown authority, safety, independence, or reproducibility facts yield unverified rather than pass.

acceptance_criteria.claim: Runtime activation is proven only by runtime-owned telemetry for project loading, fresh-session status, selected role, effective permissions, concurrency, ticket, and package digests.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: Wrong, stale, missing, self-authored, or broader-than-authorized telemetry yields fail or unverified; static inspection alone cannot pass runtime activation.

acceptance_criteria.claim: The frozen protocol cannot drift after implementation begins.
acceptance_criteria.threshold: The protocol SHA-256 matches protocol.v1.sha256 before and after validation; mismatch aborts acceptance.

finding_coverage.F1: Role safety and reviewer independence not fail-closed
finding_coverage.F2: Canonical state and approvals lack authoritative persistence and verification
finding_coverage.F3: Budget, delegation-depth, retry, and action-chain limits are declarative only
finding_coverage.F4: No reproducible package validation suite or compatibility evidence
finding_coverage.F5: Runtime, model, policy, config, and role provenance is underspecified
finding_coverage.F6: Canonical gate and environment vocabulary drift
finding_coverage.F7: Primary orchestrator does not automatically receive its full contract
finding_coverage.F8: Risk and team-efficiency rules are contradictory
